current_behavior:
(1) AGENT CODE. The checkout card app.template.html:1986-1996 renders `#cAgentCode` with the HTML `required` attribute, a red `*`, the hint "एजेन्ट कोड अनिवार्य छ। एजेन्ट नभए "अन्य / Other" थिच्नुहोस्।" and a `#cAgentOther` "Other (Direct Sale)" button. The live site serves identical markup (curl https://www.shreehariglobal.in/ lines 1782-1792). Nothing hides it for customers (no CSS hit for agentCodeField; only 14-counter.js:382-398 swaps it for a SELECT in staff sessions). BUT the JS gate is staff-only: 07-checkout.js:226-230 `if (ctrSell) { const agEl = $('#cAgentCode'); const agOk = !agEl || (agEl.value||'').trim().length > 0; … fails.push('एजेन्ट कोड / Agent Code') }` and coSyncContinue 07-checkout.js:276-279 `if (ctrSell2) { … if (acEl && !(acEl.value||'').trim()) ready = false; }`, where ctrSell = `SHG_BOOT.staff.canSell` (07-checkout.js:198) and index.php:88-99 adds `staff` only when `Auth::admin() !== null`. The `required` attribute is inert: #view-checkout (1898-2150) sits in no `<form>` (forms close at 728, 877, 1723, 2792, 2832) and the buttons are type="button". History: b9e8c75 (PR #12) made the check unconditional for everyone and added `required`/Other; 2c7e509 (later the same day) rewrote it as `if (ctrSell)`; the merge ea39cbc kept the staff-only gate plus the customer-facing "mandatory" markup. Server: api/book.php:110-112 treats referralCode/agentCode as optional; booking.php:164-166 resolves via AgentWallet::resolveAgentCodeFromString (null → direct sale), stores `referral_code` as typed (booking.php:503). Verified on localhost:8951: referralCode "" → 200 pnr SHG-2026-00133, agent:null, DB referral_code NULL; "OTHER" → 200, agent:{applied:false}, DB referral_code='OTHER'; "SHG-9999" → 200, applied:false. So a direct customer CAN book with no code, but the UI tells them it is mandatory; pressing Other sets value 'OTHER' (07-checkout.js:1099-1103) → submitBooking persists `shg_agent_code='OTHER'` in localStorage (1208, 03-accounts.js:89-94) which rides on every later /search.php call (05-router.js:2063-2064) and shows the toast "Agent code not recognised — booked as direct sale." (1308-1311).

(2) SCREENS / CLICKS. Router 05-router.js:122-124: '#/results' needs Flow.date, '#/seats' needs Flow.route, '#/checkout' needs Flow.legs — else redirect home. Flow is an in-memory const (05-router.js:6). Path: HOME #searchForm (date strip tap, direction pill default "Going to Nepal", #pointSel town, "Search buses" → 05-router.js:1881-1896 sets Flow.autoSkip) → RESULTS (06-results.js:200-202 "Select" button; with one bookable card autoSkip clicks it and `location.replace('#/seats')` 256-261/349, so the results screen is normally skipped) → SEATS (seat tap holds via SeatSrv → /api/lock.php 05-router.js:2240; #seatQuick name/phone/gender appears once a seat is picked, 06-results.js:1421-1433, written to window.SHG_QUICK; #boardingSel/#dropSel pre-selected by server boardingIdx 869-876; Continue 1284-1334) → CHECKOUT step 1 #coStep1 (#cPhone + #cCountry, optional email/ID, Quick Rules, #agreeTnc, pax rows: ONE lead name for the group, age/gender optional, per-seat names opt-in 07-checkout.js:612-690, agent-code card, "Continue to Payment" → coGoStep(2) 291-311 which silently signs the customer in via /api/otp.php 'quick' with name+mobile, no OTP, otp.php:59-100) → step 2 #payCard (UPI/eSewa/Link/COD tabs, QR, proof = screenshot upload or UTR, "Confirm your seat" → submitBooking: proof required unless COD 1133-1163, client dup confirm, re-POST /search.php to resolve numeric routeId 1245, POST /api/book.php 1279-1297, POST /api/payment.php with proof 1352-1374, hash '#/ticket/PNR' 1392) → STATUS #view-status. Happy-path count: 4 screens (home, seats, checkout×2 panels, ticket) + results when >1 bus; ≈10-12 taps and 2-3 typed fields (name, phone, agent code/Other, UTR). Name+mobile capture points: QuickBot card #qtName/#qtPhone (second path via /api/quick-ticket.php customer_plan/customer_sell), seat view #seatQuick, checkout #paxRows/.pxName + #cPhone; later ones are prefilled from SHG_QUICK (07-checkout.js:782-790), PaxMemory, shg_cust_contact (720-745), USER (749-756). #pvOverlay (template 2186-2194) asks Sender Name + Mobile again on proof resubmission (its trigger not traced).

(3) TERMS: #agreeTnc checkbox inside checkout step 1 (template ~1966) with a link to #/terms; enforced only for non-staff at 07-checkout.js:218-221 and 273; restored by CheckoutDraft.

(4) BOARDING/DROP: api/search.php:184-250 reads route_stops (boarding/drop by sort_order), drops departed pickups (Boarding::isOpen), encodes "Name · Landmark @ HH:MM [lat,lng]", computes boardingIdx/dropIdx by Boarding::townKey (252-273). Client fills selects from the SrvCatalog-absorbed route (06-results.js:844-859) but falls back to the hard-coded seedRoutes arrays (02-config.js:977-1010; 06-results.js:239-240, 328-329). The home town picker is NOT from the server: gujaratTownsFor returns CONFIG.mainPoints.india verbatim (05-router.js:572-575; 02-config.js:427), a hard-coded JS list duplicated server-side in Fare::mainPoints (fare.php:75-80). Local search JSON (date +2d): results[0] = {routeId:2, routeCode:'r2', scheduleId:75, slot, extraBus, from,to, busName, busNumber, coachType, depTime, arrTime, duration, dayOffset, fare:2799, fareOverride, amenities[], seatsLeft, totalSeats, boarding[10 strings], drop[1], boardingIdx:0, dropIdx:0, status, delayMinutes, state, date}; wrapper {date, requestedDate, nextAvailable, nextAvailableStop, from, to, count}. Live boarding list for r2: Surat, Kamrej, Ankleshwar, Bharuch, Vadodara, Anand, Nadiad, Emli Bhupal, S Hari Parking Nana Chiloda — no Rajkot; live from=Rajkot → count 0; 'Rajkot' exists in the repo only as map coordinates (16-lazy.js:184).

(5) PERSISTENCE: Flow (route/date/seats/legs/coStep) is memory-only → any reload lands on home. CheckoutDraft (07-checkout.js:413-493) saves pax names/age/gender, phone, email, idType/idNum, tnc to sessionStorage keyed shg:codraft:route:date:seats, restored in renderCheckout (801) — but keyFor needs Flow.legs[0], so it never survives a reload; it does not save agent code, payment method, UTR, screenshot (Flow.shotThumb) or boarding/drop. Seat holds live server-side 30 min (config.local.php:65, seat_hold_minutes) keyed by the session lock token.

(R3h) Hold: Seats::lock INSERT…ON DUPLICATE KEY on UNIQUE uq_lock_seat (seats.php:1132-1139, schema.sql:267). Create: Database::transaction + fetchForUpdate on the schedules row (seats.php:1271) + assertAvailable + claim insertIgnore on UNIQUE uq_seat_per_schedule with collision throw (seats.php:1366-1385, schema.sql:381); gender/women-only rules in the same transaction (booking.php:383-420). Server total is authoritative (apiResult.total used 07-checkout.js:1325).
